proven_findings.description: SmallCNN1D parameters match 283,692 exactly. Frozen files (configs/backbone.yaml, scripts/backbone.py) protected without mutation.
build_model helper remains locked to K=6; pipeline correctly constructs SmallCNN1D directly with num_classes=12.
Supervised test denominator mismatch (expected 3572) only logs WARNING instead of raising ValueError fail-fast.
proven_findings.recommended_fix: Raise ValueError on mismatch, matching fullstream 5053 check.

proven_findings.description: 64-sample stride overlap and >=0.6 majority threshold strictly match builder policy. Origin indexing claims conservatively deferred without unverified assertions.

hypotheses.description: Raw acc and gyro recording length mismatch defensive trimming (min_len) recommended if sensor lengths diverge.

proven_findings.description: Train-only norm fit on train split; seeds 42, 43, 44; 30 epochs; Adam lr=1e-3 wd=1e-4 cosine decay; patience 10 on val_macro_f1; test split strictly blind until post-selection checkpoint freeze.
Reentry lockout bug: line 966 checks if any file exists in out_dir when running train phase, which immediately crashes if audit phase was previously run in the same directory.
proven_findings.recommended_fix: Scope collision detection to phase-specific artifacts rather than any file.

proven_findings.description: Dead code remnant: `ckpt = torch.save if False else torch.load(ckpt_path, map_location=device)`.
run_train evaluates np.where for recall/precision/f1 without np.errstate, triggering unsuppressed runtime divide warnings for zero-prediction or zero-support classes.
proven_findings.recommended_fix: Wrap with `with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):` as is done in run_evaluate line 563.

proven_findings.description: Gap mask strictly asserts stride=64, same experiment, consecutive win_idx. Disclaimers properly clarify empirical margins and temporal stability without ECDR certification claims.
Single-thread (torch.set_num_threads(1)), batch size 1, 100 warmup, 1000 timed samples with cycling test sample indices for both forward-only and end-to-end pipelines.
run_verify only verifies that provenance_audit.json exists, but does not verify the recorded SHA-256 hashes against disk files.
proven_findings.recommended_fix: Iterate over audit_data['file_hashes'] and verify compute_sha256 matches.

proven_findings.description: run_verify recomputes predictions and logits against test_predictions.npz, but does not recompute and verify summary metrics against evaluation_results.json.
proven_findings.recommended_fix: Compute supervised test accuracy and macro-F1 on recomputed predictions and assert equality with persisted evaluation_results.json.
